note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, after 66858fa127). RFC 8654 Section 3: "Peers that wish to use the BGP Extended Message Capability MUST support error handling for BGP UPDATE messages per [RFC7606]." The two message-level units (TestRFC7606MPReachNLRIConsistentWithAFISAFIAccepted, TestRFC7606AttributeLengthConflictTreatAsWithdraw) no longer carry this tag, which removes the over-claim the previous judgement named: they never involved Extended Message. Both polarities remain, carried only by session-level units on a session that negotiated Extended Message with UPDATEs over 4096 octets: TestRFC8654TreatAsWithdrawRemovesInstalledRoutes (valid 4097-octet UPDATE installs 3 routes in Adj-RIB-In, Loc-RIB and downstream; ORIGIN=3 alone removes all three from each and withdraws downstream; a later valid UPDATE reinstalls on the same Established session with no NOTIFICATION), TestRFC8654ExtendedTwoFamilyWithdrawalRecovery, TestRFC8654ExtendedAttributeDiscard (valid ATOMIC_AGGREGATE/AGGREGATOR kept byte-exact; malformed one absent, NLRI intact, Established, no NOTIFICATION, both readers), TestRFC8654ExtendedDuplicateAttributes (exact published attributes after keep-first), TestRFC8654ExtendedDuplicateMPResets (single MP processed; duplicate gives Idle, no extra dispatch) and TestRFC8654ExtendedMessageSessionUsesRFC7606ErrorHandling (malformed ORIGIN over 1100 routes: all withdrawn, Established, no NOTIFICATION; attribute section overrunning the message: 3/1, Idle, nothing dispatched). Each unit's tags sit on distinct subtests or phases, not one assertion in two hats. Claims match the bodies. FINDING (not verdict-changing): the positive tag on TestRFC8654ExtendedMessageSessionUsesRFC7606ErrorHandling names the malformed-ORIGIN subtest, which is an error input (RFC 7606's treat-as-withdraw outcome), so that unit is two negatives; the requirement's conforming positives come from the other units. Fix: retag that line as a second negative, or add a well-formed over-4096 subtest asserting the UPDATE is dispatched with attributes and NLRI intact and keep the positive tag on it. Verdict stands.
